load_deskewed_mnist: load the MNIST dataset from TensorFlow Datasets and return deskewed images as a numpy array
deskew_dataset: deskew a dataset of images by computing moments and applying an affine transform to each image
deskew_image: deskew a single image by computing its moments and applying a shear correction via affine transform
compute_image_moments: compute the first and second statistical moments of an image including the mean vector and covariance matrix
estimate_mean_std: estimate the running mean and standard deviation of samples using Welford's online algorithm with Haiku state
